summary.result: Suggested criteria for each model performance variables were referenced from the previous research.
summary.background: The purpose of this study was to test the applicability of the HSPEXP model performance criteria for calibrating hydrologic parameters of HSPF.
summary.method: Using the HSPEXP decision-support software, hydrology parameters were adjusted based on total volume, then low flows, storm flows, and finally seasonal flows.
